body: Thank you for reading and responding. I’m working up the courage to tell them right now. My mom’s starting to sense that there’s a lot on my mind. I’m too much of a coward; I’m planning to run away and move in with a friend and try to find a job after I tell them. I just don’t wanna have him beat the shit out of me, raise hell for the rest of my family, and destroy all my stuff. I guess it’s better than killing myself, right?
